tv: Xiaomi Redmi Smart TV A Pro 55"/50" 2025 Energy-saving (MiTV-ASTR0, blueplanet, Amlogic), China firmware OS3.0.106.0 / OS3.0.119.0.USTAATV, 3 GB RAM
notes: Second HyperOS 3 Xiaomi: standby ads are the Hyper screensaver Activity itself (`com.xiaomi.mitv.hyper.screensaver`, own downloaded carousel, verified live) — disabling the usual content sources does not stop it; classic `com.mitv.screensaver`/`advertise` don't exist; PatchWall **disabled and replaced via the `com.ts.launcher` allowlist trampoline** (works on this OS3.0.106 build, as on MFFU0's OS3.0.115); keep `com.xiaomi.mitv.smartpanel` (it is the Menu-button panel); no idle clock screensaver possible (idle timeout is a hard panel-off); ADB closes on every reboot; second unit, the 50-inch on OS3.0.119, ships a different preload set (Chinese markets and streaming apps, no WPS/calendar/health/weather/Xiaomi store) and [its own list](xiaomi-mitv-astr0/debloat-50-2025.txt); the 50-inch dock and input mapping are in [its config](xiaomi-mitv-astr0/config.json); [device notes](../docs/devices/xiaomi-mitv-astr0-blueplanet.md)
